tool_config.name: switch_character
tool_config.description: Hand the visitor over to another character. Never call it in the same turn as asking whether to send them. Call it only after the visitor has answered yes to that question (for example says yes, ja, gärna, skicka mig) or directly asks to talk to that character. In the same turn, first say one short sentence such as 'Jag skickar över dig till Kocken nu.', then call this tool. Never call it for your own character.

character.description: The character to hand over to.

language.description: ISO code of the language the visitor is speaking right now.

greeting.description: One short first line for the new character, in the visitor's language, naming you as the one who sent them, without asking what they need. Example: 'Hej, Psykologen skickade dig till mig.' English: 'Hi, Psykologen sent you to me.'

question.description: The visitor's question written out in full in the visitor's language, so the new character can answer it right away, e.g. 'Vad kan jag laga med kyckling och ris?'. Empty string if they had no specific question.
